scope: Actual public host -> dedicated Worker -> fixed Bernini model/sampler owner; acceptance follows the supplied explicit saved-input shape
sourceInventory: Parse the complete generated API BUILD_SOURCES dictionary and add the two runner files, fixed Worker observer, this contract and generated build-info itself; all must equal the exact execution commit before and after running

resourceProfiles.4: Explicit four-thread operator profile; real COOP same-origin / COEP require-corp / SharedArrayBuffer, no fallback

smoke: Reject second load without discarding owner
Reject stale model session before numerical dispatch
Both HIGH and LOW explicit selection with out-of-range timestep before neural computation
Actual HIGH prefix then hard cancellation at patch progress; no fake prediction callback
Numerical retry requires load after Worker termination
Reload in a fresh realm, reject the previous model session
Canonical saved-input tensor write and actual-disk File readback; no generated sample inferred from cancelled prefix
Await unload cleanup then physical Worker termination and dispose
predict: Actual selected-side all-block prediction with explicit noise target and full supplied saved conditioning/context; persist velocity and canonical file
sample: Actual internal HIGH3 then LOW3 with explicit initial target/noise and separate positive/negative copies; persist raw generated sample, not posterior mean
sampleRecoveryProbe: Explicit runner-only --cancel-before-run: actual HIGH prefix cancel, require unloaded retry, reload in the same public API instance, reject old model session, then complete the unchanged normal sample call using the reloaded model session; compare API/model identities in receipt. This flag is not an ordinary API input
readback: POST bounded binary bytes into private O_EXCL mode0600 files, select the actual saved file again, read through public readTensor, compare canonical metadata and every F32 bit
inputOwnership: Hash caller-owned tensor/noise/Text/mask inputs before and after; public API sends no transfer list
referenceAndGate: Development comparison only; never ordinary API fields or compatibility requirements
claimsExcluded: Original workflow acceptance from a small case
